resources.string: Save deletion identities separately from recording backups. On a new installation, import this file before older recordings to keep deleted recordings from returning. This unencrypted file contains identities only, not recordings or export receipts.

Import adds restore-blocking identities only. Recordings already on this device are kept, including matching recordings. Existing deletion identities win. Preview counts can change before confirmation; import checks them again.
New identities: %1$d. Already known: %2$d. Present recordings kept: %3$d. Conflicting identity pairs skipped: %4$d.

Choose only a file you trust. Its checksum detects changed bytes but does not identify its author. Deletion times before this feature are unknown. Importing never deletes existing recordings or external files.
Deletion history was written, closed and read back successfully. This verifies this copy now; it does not guarantee future availability. No export receipt is stored for this file.
Deletion history was written but could not be verified. Local identities and recordings are retained.
Deletion history could not be exported. Local identities and recordings are retained.
Deletion history could not be inspected. No identities were imported. Finish any active recording and choose a supported, intact file.
Deletion identities imported. Existing recordings and deletion identities were kept.
